review_candidates.title: Video Editor — Long Form YouTube (Remote)
review_candidates.description: We are not looking for the editor who makes things look flashy. We're looking for the one who researches a city they've never been to until they could give you a tour of it — and then puts that on screen. Render House is a US-based agency producing documentary-style real estate content: in-depth YouTube videos about American cities, neighborhoods, and developments. Our clients talk about specific places — a street, a waterfront, a development going up on the east side. Your job is to make the viewer feel like they're standing there. That means understanding what the place actually looks like, and sourcing the exact right footage — never something that just looks close enough. Here's the kind of work you'd be cutting: https://youtu.be/wcoSH__YaLA https://youtu.be/cgM53p8n-mA https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wfCZkUq_Ng8 Note: this role requires strong English. You'll be cutting talking-head videos where every editorial decision depends on understanding exactly what's being said. We are hiring now and review applications daily. Shortlisted editors hear back within 48 hours. WHAT YOU WILL DO Research the client's city before you cut a single frame — its layout, its landmarks, its neighborhoods, what it's known for, what it's NOT Edit 1–2 long-form videos per week (15–25 minutes), talking head + heavy B-roll Source B-roll that matches the SPECIFIC place being discussed (YouTube, Google Earth, stock, Google Images) — and verify it's really that place before it goes on screen Build the narrative: pacing, structure, and the visual logic that makes a 20-minute video feel like a guided tour, not a slideshow Use our Google Earth Studio and Drag & Drop templates for Data Placeholders, lower thirds and map flyovers (templates provided) WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Genuine curiosity about places — you'd enjoy spending an hour learning a city you'll never visit A research habit: you check, you verify, you don't guess Long-form YouTube editing experience with strong instincts for pacing and retention Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects Strong English — full comprehension of spoken content is essential Able to work independently and make smart editorial calls THE SETUP Fully remote, full-time, long-term You need your own editing-capable computer and stable internet Pay: Starts at $400–800 USD per month Start: as soon as we find the right editor

Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our Culture We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. Location: Remote - Ireland From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere! We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About The Role As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management. You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements. This is an ideal role for someone who brings deep technical expertise, thrives in high-ownership environments, and is excited to shape the future of DevOps. What You'll Be Doing Own and evolve our DevOps and platform engineering function, from build and deployment pipelines to monitoring, infrastructure as code, and cost optimization. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that are secure, scalable, and built to support rapid product iterations without sacrificing stability. Improve observability via Datadog, GCP, and custom dashboards, including FinOps focused observability outcomes. Implement and maintain FinOps governance, including showback and chargeback models, to drive cost accountability across engineering teams. Enable developer productivity by creating internal tooling, reusable modules, and simplifying infrastructure for other engineering teams. Help teams define and measure SLOs setting the standard for how we think about system health and reliability. Serve as a FinOps thought leader, collaborating with Product and Engineering to define the most cost-effective architectural patterns for new services and features. Play a key role in shaping our engineering culture, DevOps best practices, and influencing our long-term DevOps roadmap. Work cross-functionally with product engineering, security, finance, and other teams to align technical spending with business unit economics and financial goals. What You'll Need 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or software engineering roles, ideally in high-growth startup environments Proficiency in Python or Go, with strong software engineering fundamentals Proven ownership of production infrastructure and platform tooling, with strong debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and diagnose unforeseen financial spikes Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing highly secure and robust infrastructure, particularly in environments with stringent regulatory requirements such as those used by government agencies and major financial institutions Deep experience with Kubernetes and tools like ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform Familiarity with GCP (preferred) or other major cloud providers, with a deep focus on cloud cost management, leveraging reserved instances/savings plans, and implementing cost anomaly detection Hands-on experience with dedicated FinOps tooling (e.g., Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Cloud Billing, DoIT Cloud Intelligence) or building custom tooling for cost allocation and reporting. Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines and internal developer tooling from the ground up Hands-on experience with observability tools like Prometheus or Datadog, and participation in an on-call rotation Benefits We Offer Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice .

review_candidates.title: Desktop Support Technician
review_candidates.description: Current Employees: If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet. The University of Miami’s UMIT Department has an exciting opportunity for a Full-time Desktop Support Technician to work in Coral Gables, Florida. The Desktop Support Technician provides technical user advice and support to academic and administrative staff for problems and questions related to network communications. The Desktop Support Technician (A) monitors systems and advises senior staff of network application status. Core Responsibilities: Acts as first point of contact in the problem determination process, for desktop and network issues. Provides quality customer service to all clients in a timely and professional manner. Organizes and prioritizes support requests. Monitors, administers, tracks, and verifies completion of help desk tickets. Assists staff with the installation, configuration, and ongoing usability of desktop computers, peripheral equipment, and software. Prepares, installs, tests, and certifies any desktop configuration, including software drivers. Conducts basic troubleshooting for desktop and laptop computers. Applies migration from the previous PC and executes PC hardware moves. Software installation and configuration on workstations. Verifies software is functional and escalates issues. Decommissions any existing hardware that has been replaced. Completes, updates, and closes Service Center tickets. Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets. Develops and periodically refines systems and procedures for efficiently handling customer service calls. Provides technical expertise and assists clients in sophisticated problem determination and resolution. Prioritize and respond to service requests. Provide technical and audio/visual support for lectures, presentations, symposiums and conferences. Provide video conferencing support for faculty and staff presentations, lectures and dissertations. Assist departmental and program requests regarding video capture and streaming for online and hybrid curricula. Department Specific Functions: Provide desktop and audiovisual support to 20+ departments and interdisciplinary programs across multiple buildings on the University’s Coral Gables campus as part of the College of Arts and Sciences distributed IT team. Partner with the supervisor to assess projects and identify technology needs. Install, configure, and troubleshoot faculty and staff workstations, lab computers, mobile devices, and peripherals (including research instruments). Requires strong working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Microsoft Office. Proactively monitor, maintain, and optimize endpoint performance, applying updates, patches, and preventative maintenance. Enforce university IT security policies, including endpoint protection, encryption, MFA, and access controls. Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to support consistent service delivery. Assist in developing and improving IT service workflows, escalation paths, and response procedures. Provide prompt, professional support in person and remotely, documenting all requests and incidents in ServiceNow. Support faculty with classroom technology and digital teaching tools, and provide on-site AV support for special events. Maintain asset inventory using the department’s asset management platform. Collaborate with central IT teams and other school-based IT units on cross-functional initiatives. This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: High school diploma or equivalent CompTIA A+ Certification preferred but not required. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail. Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work under pressure while meeting deadlines. Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion. Ability to work evenings, nights, and weekends as necessary. Commitment to the University’s core values. Ability to work independently and/or in a collaborative environment. Proficiency in computer software (i.e. Microsoft Office). Any appropriate combination of relevant education, experience and/or certifications may be considered. The University of Miami is recognized as one of the nation’s premier research institutions and academic health systems and is among the largest employers in South Florida. With more than 20,000 faculty and staff, the University is committed to excellence and guided by a mission to positively impact the lives of students, patients, and communities locally and globally. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute meaningfully. United by shared values, the University community works together to build an environment defined by purpose, collaboration, and service. The University of Miami is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are protected from discrimination based on certain categories protected by Federal law. Click here for additional information. Job Status: Full time Employee Type: Staff

review_candidates.description: Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop new and highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics in order to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board and system design. Position Overview: The Siemens EDA Global Support team is seeking a dynamic support engineer for the Xpedition Enterprise tools suite. Building EDA experience and PCB design skills, this individual will work directly with internal and external customers to resolve tool issues, partner with account teams to educate users and grow product usage and create knowledge content for the web-based support portal. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following activities: Proactively help customers quickly become productive with Xpedition PCB design tools. Help customers achieve project deadlines by providing support by phone, electronic means or on-site. Engage with existing customers to understand and provide guidance for their PCB design methodology. Assist account teams with struggling customers to overcome challenges. Interface with customers and Electronic Board Systems engineering and provide feedback in both directions. Regularly participate in meetings and conference calls with customers, both internal and external. Work as part of the account team to develop solutions for customer issues and take an active role to communicate these solutions to the customer. Capture knowledge for web-based support systems in the form of articles, white papers and videos. Provide proactive customer feedback into product marketing and engineering to drive improvement and future evolution of the product line. Actively participate in marketing and sales activities such as, workshops, seminars, etc. Provide first-line support for all tools in the Xpedition tool suite. Support coverage focused on the western United States, collaborating with the worldwide team. Required Qualifications: Broad knowledge in electrical system design. Detailed understanding of Xpedition Enterprise tools Self-motivated with the ability to work independently but collaboratively and to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving product and technical environment. Ability to build strong rapport and credibility with customers’ organizations while maintaining an internal network of contacts. Manage multiple tasks and customer issues concurrently. Strong technical communication skills and presentation skills. BSEE or BSME, 5+ years of electrical system design experience desired. US citizenship or permanent residency, located in the USA. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of the ECAD Library development and design data management. Siemens Xpedition Enterprise EDM preferred. Familiarity with scripting languages such as VBScript and Python. Prior scripting experience with Xpedition is a plus. Strong project management and communication skills – both written and verbal. Prior project management experience a plus. Familiarity with Xpedition DFM/Valor DFM. Familiarity with IT/networking troubleshooting Working Conditions/Physical Requirements: Role will be hybrid with some flexibility in location. Will support discussions in various time zones, so virtual meetings outside of home time zone will sometimes be necessary. This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license. Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us #SWSaaS The pay range for this position is $90,000 - $162,000 annually with a target incentive of 3-5% of the base salary. Position Overview We are seeking a high-energy, experienced Services Program Manager to join our Consulting Services team. In this key role, you will drive the successful execution of electronic design services projects. We're looking for a leader with a proven track record of building customer loyalty through clear, consistent delivery and strategic project management. You'll collaborate across account teams and technical leadership to identify opportunities, scope projects accurately, and ensure exceptional customer outcomes. Key Responsibilities Collaborate strategically with account teams and technical leads to drive successful sales campaigns and identify new business opportunities within the EDA/PCB design services space. Capture customer objectives and requirements using structured intake forms and comprehensive discovery processes. Lead the technical scoping process with assigned technical leads, translating customer requirements into detailed project effort estimates and compelling project proposals. Develop, maintain, and adapt comprehensive project plans—including scope, schedule, budget, resources, and deliverables—using industry-standard project management tools. Oversee and drive project execution, ensuring adherence to project plans, quality standards, and customer expectations while proactively managing dependencies and roadblocks. Implement robust project governance frameworks, track key performance indicators, and provide clear, data-driven reports to stakeholders on project status, risks, and progress. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues, developing contingency plans and escalating as appropriate to ensure project success. Cultivate and maintain strong, strategic customer relationships throughout the project lifecycle, serving as the primary point of contact and driving high customer satisfaction. Champion continuous improvement initiatives in project delivery processes, tools, and metrics to enhance efficiency, quality, and business outcomes. Qualifications Hands-on experience leading complex electronic design projects from concept to completion. Looking for 8+ years of experience. Profound understanding and practical application of the PCB development lifecycle, including design, layout, library management, and New Product Introduction (NPI) processes. Proficiency in High-Speed Design (HSD) analysis, simulation tools, and related methodologies, with the ability to guide technical discussions. Demonstrated experience managing cloud-based solutions, SaaS deployments, or managed services within the EDA or PCB design domain. Deep expertise in project governance and various project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid); PMP or equivalent certification (PRINCE2, Agile) is highly preferred. Strong customer-centric approach with a proven track record of successful customer engagements and contract renewals. review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - Solutions Engineering
review_candidates.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations. We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative. The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu. Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure. This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. What you will do Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code Follow agile software development practices Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events Who you are You are a passionate Python developer You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking You are a lifelong learner Bonus points for You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field Golang programming skills What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Affinity Power & Control   Affinity Power & Control is one of the MENA region's leading specialists in power and control systems. From our base in Jordan, we design, supply, and commission SCADA and automation, PV solar, substations, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale clients across the region. Our work spans 20+ countries and ranges from single-site industrial installations to large utility-scale renewable projects, delivering more than 7 GW of smart energy and control infrastructure to date. We partner with developers, EPCs, consultants, and utilities who need solutions that are both technically rigorous and commercially sound , and we back every system we sell with a strong in-house engineering team, from first design through commissioning and beyond.   About the Position This is a client-facing, field-oriented role that bridges technical engineering and business development. You'll grow revenue by winning new clients, deepening existing relationships, and translating complex technical solutions into clear, compelling commercial proposals.   You don't need to have sold SCADA systems before. What matters is that you come from a technical sales background , ideally electrical engineering or renewable energy , and that you can learn our solutions quickly, explain them simply, and earn the trust of engineers, consultants, and decision-makers. Our technical team will support you on the specifics; we'll rely on you to own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome.   If you're technically curious, comfortable managing long sales cycles, and motivated by clean energy and smart infrastructure, this role is built for you.   What You'll Do   Business Development & Sales   Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across our solution areas , PV solar, SCADA and automation, substations, and BESS , in commercial, industrial, and utility-scale segments.   Approach and qualify new clients: factories, developers, EPCs, consultants, and utilities.   Prepare quotations, proposals, and tenders in response to client RFQs and RFPs, in coordination with the technical team.   Lead and support commercial negotiations through to contract award.   Own the full sales cycle and consistently meet or exceed monthly and annual targets.   Technical & Pre-Sales   Run technical consultations and pre-sales discussions, articulating system capabilities, integration needs, and value in terms the client understands.   Work closely with the engineering team so that every proposal is technically feasible and aligned with project scope and design standards.   Support the preparation of high-level system concepts and functional specifications for client review during the pre-sales phase.   Act as the primary point of contact from first inquiry through contract award, then hand over cleanly to the delivery team.   Client & Market Development   Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients, consultants, EPCs, and key stakeholders in the energy sector.   Track market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies, and feed insights back into our go-to-market approach.   Represent Affinity at exhibitions, industry forums, and client events to strengthen our presence and generate leads.   Support marketing efforts through project showcasing, lead generation, and input into company profiles and presentations.   Reporting & Coordination   Maintain accurate records of your pipeline, forecasts, targets, and client interactions using CRM tools.   Prepare regular, clear performance reports on sales and opportunities.   Coordinate with procurement and project management to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and on budget.   Support project kick-off and scope clarification to keep customer satisfaction high after the sale.  What You'll Bring   Education   Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechatronics, Communications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.   Additional background in Business, Marketing, or Project Management is a plus.     Experience   Minimum 3 years in technical or B2B sales, business development, or pre-sales , ideally in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or industrial/energy systems.   A proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a technical selling environment.   Direct experience with SCADA, automation, PV solar, or BESS is a strong advantage but not required , we'll support the right candidate in building this knowledge.     Technical Understanding (advantage, and developed on the job)   Familiarity with power systems, control, and communications is valued: SCADA platforms, PLCs/HMIs, Power Plant Controllers, and protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, or IEC 61850.   Comfort reading and commenting on single-line diagrams, system architectures, and technical specifications.   A general grasp of Ethernet and TCP/IP networking as it relates to automation systems.   Where you don't yet have this depth, a genuine willingness and ability to learn it quickly is what counts.     Skills   Strong sales, negotiation, and persuasion skills.   The ability to translate technical concepts into simple, practical language for a commercial audience.   Confident presentation and proposal-writing skills.   Sharp analytical skills , able to read client needs, spot gaps, and propose tailored solutions.   Well organized, able to manage multiple opportunities under tight deadlines.   A collaborative approach, working comfortably alongside engineering, procurement, and project management.   Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.     Languages   Fluency in Arabic and English (minimum High B2 / C1 level).     Other Requirements     Willingness to travel to client and project sites within Jordan and, as needed, the wider region.   A valid driver's license and willingness to use your own car for business travel (mileage/travel reimbursed per company policy).     Why Affinity   Work at the front edge of the region's clean-energy and smart-infrastructure transition.   Sell solutions you can stand behind, backed by a strong technical team.   A role with real ownership of client relationships and commercial outcomes, and clear targets to grow against.
